name: jee-cbt-platform
description: JEE Main + JEE Advanced CBT Practice Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../api && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
